messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout for service `gateway` -> v2.14.0 to production. Change window: midnight-02:00 UTC. Canary 5% for 10m. Runbook (graceful unwind): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-unwind.md :spiral_note_pad:

maria.g: watching app and latency dashboards. will tag if p95 > 280ms for >3m.

lee: if error-rate jump >0.5% or 5xxs cross 0.8% in canary group, we hit the abort path. See runbook section "abort criteria". @tim.sre you up for triage?

tim.sre: on it — alerted. currently baseline 5xx=0.05%. getting small uptick on canary, +0.6% over baseline, 2m in.

jordan.rc: holding on rollout if spike holds 3m. prepping rollback notes and release-note snippet for rollback. also adding short blurb to incident channel.

maria.g: seeing increased tail latency on canary nodes: p99 jumped from 420ms -> 980ms across 3 hosts. tagging with :warning:. pausing metrics window to 5m to confirm.

lee: thanks. can we pin traffic back to v2.13.9 while we investigate? prefer unpin+fast-fallback instead of full database-migration revert. runbook link for pin/unpin: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pinning-procedures.md

jordan.rc: execute plan: 1) pause rollout 2) pin stable v2.13.9 on edge 3) run unwind checklist 4) open postmortem ticket. tagging ops team.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by jordan.rc. Canary traffic frozen at 5%.

tim.sre: confirmed error-rate stabilizing but latency still high on canary hosts. logs show increased queue depth on inference-worker-7. suspect model compilation hot path under new kernel.

maria.g: ok let's revert model kernel selection — but that requires code pin. for fastest user impact we should pin traffic and then rollback service to v2.13.9. Jordan, do the pin and then trigger rollback.

lee: accepted. run the rollback command in ops-run: ``/deploy rollback gateway --to v2.13.9 --reason "canary latency spike" --notify incident``

jordan.rc: running rollback now. will follow backout runbook steps and notify SRE channel. notes: keep request-level logs for 10m post-rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollback started: gateway -> v2.13.9. ETA ~3m. Actions logged: https://redwood.internal/deploys/3312345678.

tim.sre: monitoring. initial checks show 5xx falling back to baseline within 90s. p99 trending down.

maria.g: confirmed p95 back to ~230ms, p99 430ms. looks stable on canary nodes after rollback. great work.

lee: create a follow-up runbook update: add kernel/compilation notes, add metric thresholds for this model. i'll draft and assign to eng-ml.

jordan.rc: opening postmortem ticket and tagging eng-ml + runtime. summary for release notes: "Rollback to v2.13.9 due to canary latency increase; root causes under investigation; no user-facing errors observed."

deploy-bot: Rollback completed. Change closed. If any teams want a replay, see the deploy timeline and logs at https://redwood.internal/deploys/3312345678/timeline

maria.g: thanks all — will kick off regression canary with a lower-risk kernel profile after the runtime patch. planning next deploy window in 24h. :thumbsup:
